title: 'Next' actions on every take: Animate, Extend, Upscale, Reframe, Cut out, Outpaint
gap: The server already supports these post tasks: lib/tasks.ts extend, upscale (Topaz), reframe and motion; lib/stillTools.ts upscale, outpaint and cutout via /api/generate (admitted at generationAdmission.ts:228); and the connected finishing tools in lib/higgsfield-consumer/tools.ts:48-54 (upscale_image/video, remove_background, extend_canvas, deflicker, lip_sync). In /suites only Cast uses two of them (CastStage.tsx:37). AssetInspector.tsx:52-60 offers only reference, retry, preview, download, copy, move and delete.
target: Add a 'Next' action row to AssetInspector and to the selected take in Takes. Images get Animate (opens Gen › Video with the image as the start reference), Upscale, Outpaint to an aspect, Cut out and Re-edit. Videos get Extend forward/back, Upscale 4K, Reframe 9:16/1:1 and Edit (Seedance). Each action quotes /api/generate/quote and its button reads e.g. 'Upscale · N cr' before dispatchGeneration runs. The result is a new take under the same shot. Owners also see the connected tools, priced by the account.
respects_rules: Uses the existing /api/generate tasks. Each action is priced before it spends. The original take is kept.
